title.quote:
GPS++: A N O PTIMISED H YBRID MPNN/T RANSFORMER FOR
M OLECULAR P ROPERTY P REDICTION

extractions.description: This paper presents GPS++, a hybrid MPNN/Transformer model for molecular property prediction, specifically the HOMO-LUMO energy gap. It aims to accelerate the development of machine learning methods for molecular property prediction, benefiting fields like computational chemistry, material sciences, and drug discovery. The model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the PCQM4Mv2 dataset.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper discusses applications in material science and drug discovery, it does not explicitly focus on Sustainable Development goals.

primary_category.justification: The paper is about a model to predict molecular properties, which can accelerate material discovery. New material discovery can lead to new climate technologies, such as better batteries, better solar panels, etc. Discovering those new materials faster would require less capital.
primary_category.quote:
The PCQM4Mv2 dataset [Hu et al., 2021] is specifically aimed at aiding the development of machine learning methods
for molecular property prediction. The task presented is to predict the HOMO-LUMO energy gap of a molecule, a
property that is typically calculated using Density Functional Theory (DFT) [Kohn and Sham, 1965].
